name: St. Maria Goretti
bio:
Maria was born in 1890 in Corinaldo, Italy, into a poor farming family. After her father died, she helped her mother care for her younger siblings while working in the fields.

In 1902, at the age of eleven, she was attacked by a neighbor who tried to assault her. She resisted, telling him it was a sin, and he stabbed her fourteen times. She forgave her attacker before dying the next day, July 6, 1902.

Her attacker later repented and attended her canonization in 1950. She is venerated as the patron saint of youth and of victims of assault.
prayer: St. Maria Goretti, virgin and martyr, pray for all who suffer violence and for young people, that they may choose purity and forgive as you forgave. Amen.
